_doc: Nevada Nights' paved run-off, measured off the 2013 NAIP (ledger 0078 round 5). Per 3 m station and side of the live line (data/centerline.local.json, its widths), the image is read every 0.5 m outwards from the lane edge: the course's own dark asphalt is run-off; it reaches the last of that before 1.5 m of anything else, read up to 20 m. The Speedway lot's concrete around the course is NOT counted: on this mosaic it is as tan as the desert (R - B > 16 on both) and a colour reader cannot tell them apart at 0.5 m; by eye the lot (its stall lines) surrounds most of the course and desert lies toward the freeway. A 5-station median, then runs of >= 3 m for >= 12 m (gaps <= 6 m joined). Every number of the reader is [invented]; the overview beside this file is the eye check.
